records.claim: Owen Smith was born on 2 May 1970.
Owen Smith is a member of the Labour political party.
Owen Smith's spouse is Liz Smith.

records.source_span: In 2012, he joined Ed Miliband's Shadow Cabinet as Shadow Secretary of State for Wales, after Peter Hain stepped down.
records.value: Shadow Secretary of State for Wales
records.claim: In 2012, Owen Smith joined Ed Miliband's Shadow Cabinet as Shadow Secretary of State for Wales.
Owen Smith was born in Morecambe, England, UK.
Owen Smith's spouse is Elizabeth Wood (married 1995).
Owen Smith's alma mater is the University of Sussex.

records.source_span: On 14 September 2015, he was named as the new Shadow Secretary of State for Work and Pensions, following the election of Jeremy Corbyn as leader of the Labour Party.
records.value: Shadow Secretary of State for Work and Pensions
records.claim: On 14 September 2015, Owen Smith was named Shadow Secretary of State for Work and Pensions under Jeremy Corbyn.

records.source_span: Smith worked as a radio and television producer for the BBC, as a special adviser for Welsh Secretary Paul Murphy, and as a political lobbyist for Pfizer.
records.value: BBC radio and television producer, special adviser to Welsh Secretary Paul Murphy, political lobbyist for Pfizer
records.claim: Owen Smith previously worked as a radio and television producer for the BBC, as a special adviser for Welsh Secretary Paul Murphy, and as a political lobbyist for Pfizer.

records.source_span: Smith went on to serve as Shadow Welsh Secretary under Ed Miliband from 2012 until 2015
records.claim: Owen Smith served as Shadow Welsh Secretary under Ed Miliband from 2012 until 2015.

records.source_span: then as Shadow Work and Pensions Secretary under Jeremy Corbyn from 2015 until he resigned in June 2016.
records.claim: Owen Smith served as Shadow Work and Pensions Secretary under Jeremy Corbyn from 2015 until he resigned in June 2016.

records.source_span: On 13 July 2016, he contested the leadership of the Labour Party and was defeated.
records.claim: On 13 July 2016, Owen Smith contested the Labour Party leadership election and was defeated.

records.source_span: After the 2017 general election, Corbyn appointed Smith as Shadow Secretary of State for Northern Ireland.
records.value: Shadow Secretary of State for Northern Ireland
records.claim: After the 2017 general election, Owen Smith was appointed Shadow Secretary of State for Northern Ireland by Jeremy Corbyn.
